lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron that a suspicious spot means isolation for three days if the hair is not white.
If the sore has faded and not spread at the second checkup, the priest pronounces the person clean and the person washes his clothes.
If the disease covers all the skin and has all turned white, the priest pronounces the person clean.
A diseased person wears torn clothes, covers his mouth, cries out 'Unclean,' and lives alone beside the Tent of Meeting.
If the mildew has spread by the seventh day, the item is harmful and unclean, and it must be burned up.
